turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian. Rachel Lim speaking. Thanks for calling. Are you somewhere private to speak, or would another time be more convenient for you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Rachel. I'm in my office with the door closed. I've got a little time before my next consultancy meeting, so we can talk now. My FIN is F zero four four five four five zero N. My date of birth is 18 July 1971.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll keep our conversation focused. How has your work schedule been lately? We haven't had a chance to catch up.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Quite packed, actually. We're coordinating a few client projects, and my diary keeps shifting. Telephone is still best for reaching me; emails tend to get buried. The holding I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund. I want to sell that holding. The quantity I want to transact is 1,500 units. Use Japanese yen as the transaction currency. The transaction amount I am instructing is 50,000,000. Please place it as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: So your objective is to reduce your technology-sector concentration and make your portfolio less sensitive to sharp equity-market movements. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology businesses, so worsening sentiment towards that sector can amplify its declines. Market movements can also change the redemption value before your sale is priced. Do you understand that technology-sector concentration can amplify declines, and that the redemption value can still change before your sale is priced?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand those risks. The technology exposure can make declines sharper, and the value I receive can still change before pricing.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction charge for this sale is 0.25% of the sale value. You could lose part or even all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling can crystallise a loss if the redemption value is below what you invested. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss that may be crystallised by this sale?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including crystallising a loss on this sale, although the uncertainty makes me uneasy.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that would lower your concentrated exposure to technology-sector volatility and support your aim of a less market-sensitive portfolio.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Can you guarantee that following your recommendation will give me a favourable investment return?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: No, I cannot guarantee future returns or promise a favourable investment outcome.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right, Rachel. I'm a bit tense today, so please give me a moment. There, okay, I'm still here.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. Please confirm your final instruction: sell 1,500 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund using a market order, with transaction currency Japanese yen and transaction amount 50,000,000. Shall I proceed on that basis?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction exactly as you stated it. Please proceed. There's something else I should mention. A senior employee at a business held by the fund privately told me its unreleased earnings announcement will reveal a material deterioration in trading. That confidential information is why I am instructing you to sell before it becomes public.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. I need to refer that disclosure to our compliance team before taking any further steps. I'll contact you by telephone after their review.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay. If I'm in a meeting when you ring, I'll call you back when I'm somewhere private. Please don't leave details on voicemail.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted, I'll keep any voicemail brief and just leave my name and callback details. Thank you for your time today, Adrian.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. I'll watch for your call. Bye.
